abilities.gameText: Overcome using Remote Viewing and use your Max+Min dice. You do not have to be physically present in the area you are Overcoming.

abilities.name: Illusionary Double
abilities.gameText: When you are Attacked, Defend by rolling your single Illusions die.

abilities.name: Minion Suggestion
abilities.gameText: Attack a minion using Suggestion. If that minion would be taken out, you control its next action, and then it is removed. Otherwise, Hinder it using your Min die.

abilities.name: Postcognitive Understanding
abilities.gameText: After an enemy rolls dice to take an action for their turn but before using the result, Hinder that enemy's roll using your single Postcognition die.

abilities.name: Precognitive Alteration
abilities.gameText: After an ally rolls dice to take an action for their turn but before using the result, Boost that ally's roll using your single Precognition die.

abilities.name: Psychic Analysis
abilities.gameText: Boost yourself using [Mental quality]. Either use your Max die, or use your Mid die and make it persistent.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.gameText: Attack multiple targets using Animal Control and use your Min die.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Assault
abilities.gameText: Attack using Telekinesis. Either Attack one target and use your Max die, or two targets and use your Mid die against one and your Min die against another.

abilities.name: Telepathic Whammy
abilities.gameText: Attack using Telepathy and use your Max die. Hinder the target with a persistent penalty using your Min die.

abilities.name: Displacement Assault
abilities.gameText: Attack using [power]. Either Hinder your target with your Min die or move them somewhere else in the scene.

abilities.name: Hit & Run
abilities.gameText: Attack using [power]. Defend against all Attacks against you using your Min die until your next turn.

abilities.name: Mobile Assist
abilities.gameText: Boost another hero using [power]. Attack using your Min die.

abilities.name: Mobile Dodge
abilities.gameText: When you are hit with an Attack, you may take 1 irreducible damage to have the attacker reroll their dice pool.

abilities.name: Run Down
abilities.gameText: Attack multiple targets using [power]. Use your Min die against each.

abilities.name: Minion Formation
abilities.gameText: Reduce any damage you take by the number of minions you have. Whenver damage is reduced this way, reduce the size of one of your minions.

abilities.name: Rapid Deployment
abilities.gameText: Create a minion using [power]. Use your Min die. Choose which basic action it can perform. It acts now and at the start of your turns.

abilities.name: Upgrade Minion
abilities.gameText: Boost one of your minions using [power]. You may also upgrade that minion to your Max die size, replacing its minion form.

abilities.name: Break the 4th
abilities.gameText: You may uncheck a checked off collection on your hero sheet.

abilities.name: Danger!
abilities.gameText: Attack multiple targets using [power]. If you roll doubles, one nearby ally is also hit with the Attack

abilities.name: Expect the Unexpected
abilities.gameText: Apply a bonus after rolling your action, instead of before.

abilities.name: Imitation
abilities.gameText: Use a Green action ability of a nearby ally (using the same size power/quality die they would use.)

abilities.name: Turn the Tables
abilities.gameText: Change any bonus into a penalty of equal size or vice versa.

abilities.name: Agile Form
abilities.gameText: Attack using [power]. Defend against all attacks until your next turn with your Min die.

abilities.name: Regenerating Form
abilities.gameText: Boost using [power]. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

abilities.name: Speedy Form
abilities.gameText: Hinder multiple targets using [power].

abilities.name: Towering Form
abilities.gameText: Attack multiple targets using [power].

abilities.name: Clever Form
abilities.gameText: Boost or Overcome using [power]. Use your Max die.

abilities.name: Minuscule Form
abilities.gameText: Defend using [power]. Use your Max die. Remove all penalties on you.

abilities.name: Strong Form
abilities.gameText: Attack using [power]. Use your Max die.

abilities.name: Tough Form
abilities.gameText: Reduce any physical or energy damage you take by 1 while you are in the Green zone, 2 while in the Yellow zone, and 3 while in the Red zone.

abilities.name: Tricky Form
abilities.gameText: Boost or Hinder using [power]. Use your Max die.

abilities.name: Weird Form
abilities.gameText: When an opponent would Attack you in close combat while in this form, you may Attack or Hinder them first by rolling your single [power] die.

abilities.name: Helpful Analysis
abilities.gameText: One nearby ally may reroll their dice pool. You lose Health equal to the Min die of the new roll.

abilities.name: Snap Decision
abilities.gameText: Boost yourself using [power]. Use your Max+Min dice. Then Attack using your Mid die with that bonus.

abilities.name: Turn the Tables
abilities.gameText: Change any bonus into a penalty of equal size or vice versa.

abilities.name: Alternate Outcome
abilities.gameText: When a nearby enemy rolls their dice pool for the turn, you may lose 1 Health to reroll their entire pool.

abilities.name: Helpful Analysis
abilities.gameText: One nearby ally may reroll their dice pool. You lose Health equal to the Min die of the new roll.

abilities.name: Never Happened
abilities.gameText: When a nearby enemy would create a bonus or penalty, you may remove it immediately.

abilities.name: Retroactive Rewrite
abilities.gameText: You may apply a bonus to a roll after rolling instead of before.

abilities.name: Quick Switch
abilities.gameText: Destroy one bonus on you. Change modes, then take an action in the new mode.

abilities.name: Analysis
abilities.gameText: Hinder or use one of your principles to Overcome using [power]. Use your Max+Min dice.

abilities.name: Bombardment
abilities.gameText: Defend yourself using [power]. You may Attack one target with your Max die.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.gameText: Defend using [power]. Use your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

abilities.name: Skirmish
abilities.gameText: Attack one target using [power]. Attack a different target with your Min die. At the end of your turn, you may change modes.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.gameText: Defend yourself and all nearby allies using [power] against each Attack until the beginning of your next turn.
